items.question: Trong câu "Developers, when time runs out and they must choose based on what is easiest or most interesting.", từ "run out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Developers, when time runs out and they must choose based on what is easiest or most interesting.", what does "run out" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to be used up, to have none left
items.explanation: run out /rʌn aʊt/ (cụm từ): hết, cạn kiệt. "Time/money runs out" = hết thời gian/tiền; "run out of something" = dùng hết thứ gì.
items.explanationEn: run out /rʌn aʊt/ (phrase): to be used up, to have none left. "Time runs out" means no time is left; "run out of something" means to use all of it.

items.question: Trong câu "Whoever speaks loudest, when every decision is made in a meeting by the most persistent person.", từ "persistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whoever speaks loudest, when every decision is made in a meeting by the most persistent person.", what does "persistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: persistent /pəˈsɪstənt/ (tính từ): kiên trì, dai dẳng. Chỉ người cứ nhắc đi nhắc lại cho đến khi đạt được điều mình muốn; "persistent storage" là nghĩa kỹ thuật khác (lưu trữ bền).
items.explanationEn: persistent /pəˈsɪstənt/ (adjective): refusing to give up, insistent. Describes someone who keeps pushing until they get their way; "persistent storage" is a different, technical sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Chance, when things get done in the order they were requested.", từ "request" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Chance, when things get done in the order they were requested.", what does "request" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: request /rɪˈkwest/ (động từ): yêu cầu, đề nghị. "Request a feature" = đề nghị một tính năng; trang trọng hơn "ask for".
items.explanationEn: request /rɪˈkwest/ (verb): to ask for formally. "Request a feature" means formally ask for it; it is more formal than "ask for".

items.question: Trong câu "The consequence of unclear priorities: when the schedule slips, a key person leaves, or an urgent request arrives, management does not know how to respond — and every cut becomes a political crisis.", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequence of unclear priorities: when the schedule slips, a key person leaves, or an urgent request arrives, management does not know how to respond — and every cut becomes a political crisis.", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɒnsɪkwəns/ (danh từ): hậu quả. "The consequence of X" = hậu quả của X; "as a consequence" = do đó.
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɒnsɪkwəns/ (noun): a result or effect. "The consequence of X" is what X leads to; "as a consequence" means as a result.

items.question: Trong câu "The consequence of unclear priorities: when the schedule slips, a key person leaves, or an urgent request arrives, management does not know how to respond — and every cut becomes a political crisis.", từ "slip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequence of unclear priorities: when the schedule slips, a key person leaves, or an urgent request arrives, management does not know how to respond — and every cut becomes a political crisis.", what does "slip" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to fall behind, to be delayed
items.explanation: slip /slɪp/ (động từ): bị trễ, lùi lại. "The schedule/deadline slips" = tiến độ bị trễ; nghĩa gốc là "trượt chân".
items.explanationEn: slip /slɪp/ (verb): to fall behind, to be delayed. "The schedule slips" means it falls behind; the literal sense is to slide and lose your footing.

items.question: Trong câu "The consequence of unclear priorities: when the schedule slips, a key person leaves, or an urgent request arrives, management does not know how to respond — and every cut becomes a political crisis.", từ "urgent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequence of unclear priorities: when the schedule slips, a key person leaves, or an urgent request arrives, management does not know how to respond — and every cut becomes a political crisis.", what does "urgent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: urgent /ˈɜːdʒənt/ (tính từ): khẩn cấp. "An urgent request/issue" = yêu cầu/sự cố khẩn cấp cần xử lý ngay.
items.explanationEn: urgent /ˈɜːdʒənt/ (adjective): needing immediate action. "An urgent request" must be dealt with immediately.

items.question: Trong câu "The consequence of unclear priorities: when the schedule slips, a key person leaves, or an urgent request arrives, management does not know how to respond — and every cut becomes a political crisis.", từ "respond" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequence of unclear priorities: when the schedule slips, a key person leaves, or an urgent request arrives, management does not know how to respond — and every cut becomes a political crisis.", what does "respond" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: respond /rɪˈspɒnd/ (động từ): phản ứng, đáp lại. "Respond to a change/request" = phản ứng trước thay đổi/yêu cầu; danh từ là "response".
items.explanationEn: respond /rɪˈspɒnd/ (verb): to react or reply. "Respond to a change" means react to it; the noun is "response".

items.question: Trong câu "The consequence of unclear priorities: when the schedule slips, a key person leaves, or an urgent request arrives, management does not know how to respond — and every cut becomes a political crisis.", từ "crisis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequence of unclear priorities: when the schedule slips, a key person leaves, or an urgent request arrives, management does not know how to respond — and every cut becomes a political crisis.", what does "crisis" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: crisis /ˈkraɪsɪs/ (danh từ): khủng hoảng. "A political crisis" = khủng hoảng mang tính tranh giành quyền lợi; số nhiều là "crises".
items.explanationEn: crisis /ˈkraɪsɪs/ (noun): a time of serious difficulty. "A political crisis" is a serious conflict over power and interests; the plural is "crises".

items.question: Trong câu "The most common stakeholder response.", từ "stakeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most common stakeholder response.", what does "stakeholder" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person with an interest in a project
items.explanation: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkhəʊldə/ (danh từ): bên liên quan. Trong dự án, stakeholder là bất kỳ ai bị ảnh hưởng hoặc có quyền lợi: khách hàng, quản lý, người dùng.
items.explanationEn: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkhəʊldə/ (noun): a person with an interest in a project. In a project, a stakeholder is anyone affected by or interested in it: customers, managers, users.

items.question: Trong câu "How to handle it — invert the question.", từ "invert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to handle it — invert the question.", what does "invert" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to turn upside down or reverse
items.explanation: invert /ɪnˈvɜːt/ (động từ): đảo ngược. "Invert the question" = đặt câu hỏi theo chiều ngược lại để buộc người nghe lựa chọn.
items.explanationEn: invert /ɪnˈvɜːt/ (verb): to turn upside down or reverse. "Invert the question" means ask it the other way round to force a choice.

items.question: Trong câu "Forcing a choice between concrete options produces honest answers.", từ "concrete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Forcing a choice between concrete options produces honest answers.", what does "concrete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concrete /ˈkɒŋkriːt/ (tính từ): cụ thể, rõ ràng. "Concrete example/options" = ví dụ/lựa chọn cụ thể; danh từ "concrete" còn là bê tông.
items.explanationEn: concrete /ˈkɒŋkriːt/ (adjective): specific and definite. "Concrete options" are specific ones; as a noun, "concrete" is the building material.

items.question: Trong câu "Conflict between stakeholders.", từ "conflict" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Conflict between stakeholders.", what does "conflict" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: conflict /ˈkɒnflɪkt/ (danh từ): xung đột, mâu thuẫn. "Conflict between A and B" = mâu thuẫn giữa A và B; "resolve a conflict" = giải quyết mâu thuẫn.
items.explanationEn: conflict /ˈkɒnflɪkt/ (noun): a serious disagreement. "Conflict between A and B" is a clash of interests; you "resolve a conflict".

items.question: Trong câu "you need one decision-maker with authority and a transparent framework based on business value rather than who speaks loudest.", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you need one decision-maker with authority and a transparent framework based on business value rather than who speaks loudest.", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /ɔːˈθɒrəti/ (danh từ): quyền hạn. "Have the authority to decide" = có quyền quyết định; "the authorities" (số nhiều) là chính quyền.
items.explanationEn: authority /ɔːˈθɒrəti/ (noun): the power to make decisions. "Have the authority to decide" means having the power; "the authorities" means government bodies.

items.question: Trong câu "you need one decision-maker with authority and a transparent framework based on business value rather than who speaks loudest.", từ "transparent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you need one decision-maker with authority and a transparent framework based on business value rather than who speaks loudest.", what does "transparent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: transparent /trænsˈpærənt/ (tính từ): minh bạch, rõ ràng. "A transparent process" = quy trình minh bạch, ai cũng hiểu vì sao quyết định được đưa ra.
items.explanationEn: transparent /trænsˈpærənt/ (adjective): open and easy to understand. "A transparent process" lets everyone see why decisions are made.

items.question: Trong câu "you need one decision-maker with authority and a transparent framework based on business value rather than who speaks loudest.", từ "framework" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you need one decision-maker with authority and a transparent framework based on business value rather than who speaks loudest.", what does "framework" (noun) mean?
options: khung, cơ sở (để ra quyết định)
optionsEn: a structure of rules or ideas
items.explanation: framework /ˈfreɪmwɜːk/ (danh từ): khung, cơ sở (để ra quyết định). Ở đây là bộ nguyên tắc chung để ưu tiên hoá, không phải framework lập trình.
items.explanationEn: framework /ˈfreɪmwɜːk/ (noun): a structure of rules or ideas. Here it means a shared set of rules for prioritizing, not a programming framework.

items.question: Trong câu "prioritization is collaborative — customers supply value, the team supplies cost and technical risk.", từ "collaborative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "prioritization is collaborative — customers supply value, the team supplies cost and technical risk.", what does "collaborative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: collaborative /kəˈlæbərətɪv/ (tính từ): mang tính hợp tác. "A collaborative process" = quy trình nhiều bên cùng góp phần; động từ "collaborate".
items.explanationEn: collaborative /kəˈlæbərətɪv/ (adjective): done by working together. "A collaborative process" involves several parties; the verb is "collaborate".

items.question: Trong câu "prioritization is collaborative — customers supply value, the team supplies cost and technical risk.", từ "supply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "prioritization is collaborative — customers supply value, the team supplies cost and technical risk.", what does "supply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (động từ): cung cấp. "Supply information/value" = cung cấp thông tin/giá trị; danh từ "supply" = nguồn cung.
items.explanationEn: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (verb): to provide. "Supply information" means provide it; the noun "supply" means an available amount.

items.question: Trong câu "They change as markets shift, as you learn, as competitors ship.", từ "shift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They change as markets shift, as you learn, as competitors ship.", what does "shift" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shift /ʃɪft/ (động từ): thay đổi, dịch chuyển. "Markets/priorities shift" = thị trường/ưu tiên thay đổi; "night shift" là ca đêm (nghĩa khác).
items.explanationEn: shift /ʃɪft/ (verb): to change or move. "Markets shift" means they change; "a night shift" is a different sense (a work period).

items.question: Trong câu "Revisit them regularly, especially at the start of each sprint.", từ "revisit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Revisit them regularly, especially at the start of each sprint.", what does "revisit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: revisit /ˌriːˈvɪzɪt/ (động từ): xem xét lại. "Revisit a decision/priorities" = xem xét lại quyết định/thứ tự ưu tiên.
items.explanationEn: revisit /ˌriːˈvɪzɪt/ (verb): to consider again. "Revisit a decision" means look at it again and possibly change it.

items.question: Trong câu "Mandatory; without it the release fails", từ "mandatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mandatory; without it the release fails", what does "mandatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mandatory /ˈmændətəri/ (tính từ): bắt buộc. "Mandatory field/requirement" = trường/yêu cầu bắt buộc; trái nghĩa "optional".
items.explanationEn: mandatory /ˈmændətəri/ (adjective): required. "A mandatory requirement" must be met; the opposite is "optional".

items.question: Trong câu "Important and desirable, but a temporary workaround exists", từ "desirable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Important and desirable, but a temporary workaround exists", what does "desirable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: desirable /dɪˈzaɪərəbl/ (tính từ): đáng mong muốn. "Desirable but not essential" = nên có nhưng không thiết yếu.
items.explanationEn: desirable /dɪˈzaɪərəbl/ (adjective): worth having, wanted. "Desirable but not essential" means nice to have but not required.

items.question: Trong câu "Important and desirable, but a temporary workaround exists", từ "workaround" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Important and desirable, but a temporary workaround exists", what does "workaround" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a temporary way around a problem
items.explanation: workaround /ˈwɜːkəraʊnd/ (danh từ): cách xử lý tạm thời. "A temporary workaround" = cách lách tạm để vẫn dùng được khi chưa có giải pháp chính thức.
items.explanationEn: workaround /ˈwɜːkəraʊnd/ (noun): a temporary way around a problem. "A temporary workaround" lets you continue until a proper solution exists.

items.question: Trong câu "Desirable; done if time and resources permit", từ "permit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Desirable; done if time and resources permit", what does "permit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: permit /pəˈmɪt/ (động từ): cho phép. "If time permits" = nếu thời gian cho phép; danh từ "permit" /ˈpɜːmɪt/ là giấy phép.
items.explanationEn: permit /pəˈmɪt/ (verb): to allow. "If time permits" means if there is enough time; the noun "permit" is an official licence.

items.question: Trong câu "The W is the most underrated and most useful part.", từ "underrated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The W is the most underrated and most useful part.", what does "underrated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: underrated /ˌʌndəˈreɪtɪd/ (tính từ): bị đánh giá thấp. Trái nghĩa là "overrated" (được đánh giá quá cao).
items.explanationEn: underrated /ˌʌndəˈreɪtɪd/ (adjective): valued less than it deserves. The opposite is "overrated".

items.question: Trong câu "It reassures stakeholders their idea was not discarded, merely deferred — which sharply reduces the tendency to label everything Must.", từ "reassure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It reassures stakeholders their idea was not discarded, merely deferred — which sharply reduces the tendency to label everything Must.", what does "reassure" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reassure /ˌriːəˈʃʊə/ (động từ): trấn an, làm yên lòng. "Reassure someone that..." = trấn an ai rằng...; tính từ "reassuring".
items.explanationEn: reassure /ˌriːəˈʃʊə/ (verb): to make someone less worried. "Reassure someone that..." removes their worry; the adjective is "reassuring".

items.question: Trong câu "It reassures stakeholders their idea was not discarded, merely deferred — which sharply reduces the tendency to label everything Must.", từ "discard" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It reassures stakeholders their idea was not discarded, merely deferred — which sharply reduces the tendency to label everything Must.", what does "discard" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (động từ): loại bỏ, vứt đi. "Discard an idea/changes" = bỏ ý tưởng/huỷ thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (verb): to throw away. "Discard an idea" means drop it as not useful; you can also "discard changes".

items.question: Trong câu "It reassures stakeholders their idea was not discarded, merely deferred — which sharply reduces the tendency to label everything Must.", từ "defer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It reassures stakeholders their idea was not discarded, merely deferred — which sharply reduces the tendency to label everything Must.", what does "defer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defer /dɪˈfɜː/ (động từ): hoãn lại. "Defer a feature to the next release" = dời tính năng sang bản sau; "defer to someone" là nghe theo ai.
items.explanationEn: defer /dɪˈfɜː/ (verb): to postpone. "Defer a feature" means postpone it; "defer to someone" means accept their judgement.

items.question: Trong câu "It reassures stakeholders their idea was not discarded, merely deferred — which sharply reduces the tendency to label everything Must.", từ "tendency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It reassures stakeholders their idea was not discarded, merely deferred — which sharply reduces the tendency to label everything Must.", what does "tendency" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an inclination to behave a certain way
items.explanation: tendency /ˈtendənsi/ (danh từ): xu hướng, khuynh hướng. "The tendency to do something" = xu hướng làm gì; động từ "tend to".
items.explanationEn: tendency /ˈtendənsi/ (noun): an inclination to behave a certain way. "The tendency to do something" is a likelihood of doing it; the verb is "tend to".

items.question: Trong câu "A practical guideline: many teams cap Must at about 60 percent of total effort, leaving room for uncertainty.", từ "guideline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A practical guideline: many teams cap Must at about 60 percent of total effort, leaving room for uncertainty.", what does "guideline" (noun) mean?
options: hướng dẫn, nguyên tắc chỉ đạo
items.explanation: guideline /ˈɡaɪdlaɪn/ (danh từ): hướng dẫn, nguyên tắc chỉ đạo. "Follow a guideline" = theo nguyên tắc hướng dẫn; mềm hơn "rule".
items.explanationEn: guideline /ˈɡaɪdlaɪn/ (noun): a general rule or advice. "Follow a guideline" means use advice that is softer than a strict rule.

items.question: Trong câu "A practical guideline: many teams cap Must at about 60 percent of total effort, leaving room for uncertainty.", từ "cap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A practical guideline: many teams cap Must at about 60 percent of total effort, leaving room for uncertainty.", what does "cap" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to set an upper limit on
items.explanation: cap /kæp/ (động từ): giới hạn tối đa. "Cap X at 60 percent" = giới hạn X tối đa 60%; danh từ "a cap" = mức trần.
items.explanationEn: cap /kæp/ (verb): to set an upper limit on. "Cap X at 60 percent" sets a maximum; the noun "a cap" is that limit.

items.question: Trong câu "A practical guideline: many teams cap Must at about 60 percent of total effort, leaving room for uncertainty.", từ "uncertainty" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A practical guideline: many teams cap Must at about 60 percent of total effort, leaving room for uncertainty.", what does "uncertainty" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: uncertainty /ʌnˈsɜːtnti/ (danh từ): sự không chắc chắn. "Leave room for uncertainty" = chừa khoảng trống cho những điều chưa lường trước.
items.explanationEn: uncertainty /ʌnˈsɜːtnti/ (noun): a lack of certainty. "Leave room for uncertainty" means keep capacity for the unexpected.

items.question: Trong câu "Each stakeholder gets 100 imaginary points to allocate across items by importance to them.", từ "imaginary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each stakeholder gets 100 imaginary points to allocate across items by importance to them.", what does "imaginary" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: not real, existing only in the mind
items.explanation: imaginary /ɪˈmædʒɪnəri/ (tính từ): tưởng tượng, không có thật. Khác với "imaginative" (giàu trí tưởng tượng).
items.explanationEn: imaginary /ɪˈmædʒɪnəri/ (adjective): not real, existing only in the mind. Do not confuse with "imaginative", which means creative.

items.question: Trong câu "Each stakeholder gets 100 imaginary points to allocate across items by importance to them.", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each stakeholder gets 100 imaginary points to allocate across items by importance to them.", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæləkeɪt/ (động từ): phân bổ. "Allocate budget/resources to X" = phân bổ ngân sách/nguồn lực cho X.
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæləkeɪt/ (verb): to distribute for a purpose. "Allocate resources to X" means assign them to X.

items.question: Trong câu "Advantage: it forces real trade-offs — more for this means less for that.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Advantage: it forces real trade-offs — more for this means less for that.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a balance between two competing things
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "Make a trade-off between A and B" = chấp nhận mất cái này để được cái kia.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (noun): a balance between two competing things. "A trade-off between A and B" means gaining one by giving up some of the other.

items.question: Trong câu "That is precisely what three-level prioritization fails to do.", từ "precisely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is precisely what three-level prioritization fails to do.", what does "precisely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: precisely /prɪˈsaɪsli/ (trạng từ): chính xác là. "That is precisely what..." = đó chính xác là điều...; dùng để nhấn mạnh.
items.explanationEn: precisely /prɪˈsaɪsli/ (adverb): exactly. "That is precisely what..." adds emphasis, meaning exactly that.

items.question: Trong câu "someone may dump all 100 on one item to push it to the top", từ "dump" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "someone may dump all 100 on one item to push it to the top", what does "dump" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put all at once carelessly
items.explanation: dump /dʌmp/ (động từ): dồn hết, đổ hết. "Dump everything on one item" = dồn hết vào một chỗ; trong IT "dump" còn là xuất dữ liệu (memory dump).
items.explanationEn: dump /dʌmp/ (verb): to put all at once carelessly. "Dump everything on one item" means put it all there; in IT "dump" also means export data.

items.question: Trong câu "someone may dump all 100 on one item to push it to the top → impose a cap", từ "impose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "someone may dump all 100 on one item to push it to the top → impose a cap", what does "impose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): áp đặt. "Impose a limit/rule" = áp đặt giới hạn/quy tắc.
items.explanationEn: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to enforce a rule. "Impose a limit" means officially force it on people.

items.question: Trong câu "When the investment is large and decisions are hard, you need a semiquantitative approach.", từ "semiquantitative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the investment is large and decisions are hard, you need a semiquantitative approach.", what does "semiquantitative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: semiquantitative /ˌsemiˈkwɒntɪtətɪv/ (tính từ): bán định lượng. Dùng điểm số tương đối (như 1–9) thay vì số liệu tuyệt đối; "quantitative" = định lượng.
items.explanationEn: semiquantitative /ˌsemiˈkwɒntɪtətɪv/ (adjective): partly based on numbers. It uses rough relative scores (like 1–9) rather than exact figures; "quantitative" means numerical.

items.question: Trong câu "The core principle: the highest priority belongs to items with the best VALUE-TO-COST RATIO, adjusted for risk.", từ "ratio" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The core principle: the highest priority belongs to items with the best VALUE-TO-COST RATIO, adjusted for risk.", what does "ratio" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ratio /ˈreɪʃiəʊ/ (danh từ): tỉ lệ. "Value-to-cost ratio" = tỉ lệ giá trị trên chi phí.
items.explanationEn: ratio /ˈreɪʃiəʊ/ (noun): a relationship between two amounts. "Value-to-cost ratio" compares value divided by cost.

items.question: Trong câu "The core principle: the highest priority belongs to items with the best VALUE-TO-COST RATIO, adjusted for risk.", từ "adjust" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The core principle: the highest priority belongs to items with the best VALUE-TO-COST RATIO, adjusted for risk.", what does "adjust" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: adjust /əˈdʒʌst/ (động từ): điều chỉnh. "Adjusted for risk/inflation" = đã điều chỉnh theo rủi ro/lạm phát.
items.explanationEn: adjust /əˈdʒʌst/ (verb): to change slightly to fit. "Adjusted for risk" means corrected to take risk into account.

items.question: Trong câu "This solves the biggest weakness of purely intuitive prioritization: a moderately valuable but very cheap item is often worth doing before a highly valuable but very expensive one.", từ "intuitive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This solves the biggest weakness of purely intuitive prioritization: a moderately valuable but very cheap item is often worth doing before a highly valuable but very expensive one.", what does "intuitive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: intuitive /ɪnˈtjuːɪtɪv/ (tính từ): dựa vào trực giác. Ở đây là quyết định theo cảm tính; "intuitive UI" là nghĩa khác: giao diện dễ hiểu.
items.explanationEn: intuitive /ɪnˈtjuːɪtɪv/ (adjective): based on instinct, not analysis. Here it means based on gut feeling; an "intuitive UI" is the other sense: easy to use.

items.question: Trong câu "This solves the biggest weakness of purely intuitive prioritization: a moderately valuable but very cheap item is often worth doing before a highly valuable but very expensive one.", từ "moderately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This solves the biggest weakness of purely intuitive prioritization: a moderately valuable but very cheap item is often worth doing before a highly valuable but very expensive one.", what does "moderately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: moderately /ˈmɒdərətli/ (trạng từ): ở mức vừa phải. "Moderately valuable" = có giá trị ở mức trung bình.
items.explanationEn: moderately /ˈmɒdərətli/ (adverb): to an average degree. "Moderately valuable" means fairly, but not very, valuable.

items.question: Trong câu "Four factors to estimate on a relative scale (say 1–9):", từ "relative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four factors to estimate on a relative scale (say 1–9):", what does "relative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: relative /ˈrelətɪv/ (tính từ): tương đối (so với cái khác). "On a relative scale" = chấm điểm bằng cách so sánh các hạng mục với nhau; danh từ "relative" là người thân.
items.explanationEn: relative /ˈrelətɪv/ (adjective): measured in comparison to others. "On a relative scale" means scored by comparison; the noun "relative" is a family member.

items.question: Trong câu "Relative penalty — the harm of not having it.", từ "penalty" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Relative penalty — the harm of not having it.", what does "penalty" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: penalty /ˈpenəlti/ (danh từ): thiệt hại, hình phạt. "Penalty" = cái giá phải trả; "penalty kick" trong bóng đá là quả phạt đền.
items.explanationEn: penalty /ˈpenəlti/ (noun): a loss or punishment. "Penalty" is the cost you suffer; a "penalty kick" in football is a related sense.

items.question: Trong câu "A compliance feature may have low benefit — nobody is happier for it — but enormous penalty through fines or a sales ban.", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A compliance feature may have low benefit — nobody is happier for it — but enormous penalty through fines or a sales ban.", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪəns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ (quy định). "Compliance feature" = tính năng để tuân thủ luật (VD bảo vệ dữ liệu); động từ "comply with".
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪəns/ (noun): obeying laws or rules. "A compliance feature" exists to meet legal rules; the verb is "comply with".

items.question: Trong câu "A compliance feature may have low benefit — nobody is happier for it — but enormous penalty through fines or a sales ban.", từ "enormous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A compliance feature may have low benefit — nobody is happier for it — but enormous penalty through fines or a sales ban.", what does "enormous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: enormous /ɪˈnɔːməs/ (tính từ): cực lớn. Mạnh hơn "big/large"; "an enormous impact" = tác động rất lớn.
items.explanationEn: enormous /ɪˈnɔːməs/ (adjective): extremely large. Stronger than "big"; "an enormous impact" is a huge one.

items.question: Trong câu "A compliance feature may have low benefit — nobody is happier for it — but enormous penalty through fines or a sales ban.", từ "fine" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A compliance feature may have low benefit — nobody is happier for it — but enormous penalty through fines or a sales ban.", what does "fine" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fine /faɪn/ (danh từ): tiền phạt. Danh từ "fine" = khoản tiền phạt; tính từ "fine" = ổn, tốt (nghĩa khác).
items.explanationEn: fine /faɪn/ (noun): money paid as punishment. The noun "fine" is a money penalty; the adjective "fine" means okay.

items.question: Trong câu "A compliance feature may have low benefit — nobody is happier for it — but enormous penalty through fines or a sales ban.", từ "ban" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A compliance feature may have low benefit — nobody is happier for it — but enormous penalty through fines or a sales ban.", what does "ban" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ban /bæn/ (danh từ): lệnh cấm. "A sales ban" = lệnh cấm bán; động từ "ban" = cấm.
items.explanationEn: ban /bæn/ (noun): an official prohibition. "A sales ban" forbids selling; the verb "ban" means forbid.

items.question: Trong câu "It forces a structured conversation between customers and the team, each contributing information the other lacks.", từ "lack" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It forces a structured conversation between customers and the team, each contributing information the other lacks.", what does "lack" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lack /læk/ (động từ): thiếu, không có. "Lack information/experience" = thiếu thông tin/kinh nghiệm; không dùng "lack of" sau động từ.
items.explanationEn: lack /læk/ (verb): to be without. "Lack information" means not have it; as a verb it takes no "of".

items.question: Trong câu "It exposes disagreement.", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It exposes disagreement.", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (động từ): làm lộ ra, phơi bày. "Expose a problem" = làm lộ vấn đề; trong IT "expose a port/API" là mở ra bên ngoài.
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (verb): to reveal something hidden. "Expose a problem" brings it to light; in IT you also "expose a port".

items.question: Trong câu "It separates value from cost — many arguments are really two sides discussing different dimensions without noticing.", từ "dimension" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It separates value from cost — many arguments are really two sides discussing different dimensions without noticing.", what does "dimension" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dimension /daɪˈmenʃn/ (danh từ): khía cạnh, chiều. "Different dimensions" = các khía cạnh khác nhau của một vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: dimension /daɪˈmenʃn/ (noun): an aspect of something. "Different dimensions" are different aspects of an issue.

items.question: Trong câu "Kano classifies features by how they affect customer SATISFACTION — a dimension value-cost analysis misses.", từ "classify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kano classifies features by how they affect customer SATISFACTION — a dimension value-cost analysis misses.", what does "classify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: classify /ˈklæsɪfaɪ/ (động từ): phân loại. "Classify X by Y" = phân loại X theo Y; "classified" còn nghĩa là mật.
items.explanationEn: classify /ˈklæsɪfaɪ/ (verb): to arrange into groups. "Classify X by Y" groups X by Y; "classified" can also mean secret.

items.question: Trong câu "Kano classifies features by how they affect customer SATISFACTION — a dimension value-cost analysis misses.", từ "satisfaction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kano classifies features by how they affect customer SATISFACTION — a dimension value-cost analysis misses.", what does "satisfaction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: satisfaction /ˌsætɪsˈfækʃn/ (danh từ): sự hài lòng. "Customer satisfaction" = mức hài lòng của khách hàng.
items.explanationEn: satisfaction /ˌsætɪsˈfækʃn/ (noun): a feeling of being pleased. "Customer satisfaction" measures how pleased customers are.

items.question: Trong câu "Customers take them for granted.", từ "take for granted" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Customers take them for granted.", what does "take for granted" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to assume something will always be there
items.explanation: take for granted /teɪk fə ˈɡrɑːntɪd/ (cụm từ): coi là đương nhiên. Chỉ thứ người ta không để ý đến cho tới khi nó thiếu.
items.explanationEn: take for granted /teɪk fə ˈɡrɑːntɪd/ (phrase): to assume something will always be there. Used for things nobody notices until they are missing.

items.question: Trong câu "Examples: a banking app showing the correct balance; sent email actually arriving.", từ "balance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Examples: a banking app showing the correct balance; sent email actually arriving.", what does "balance" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the amount of money in an account
items.explanation: balance /ˈbæləns/ (danh từ): số dư tài khoản. "Account balance" = số dư; "work-life balance" là nghĩa khác: sự cân bằng.
items.explanationEn: balance /ˈbæləns/ (noun): the amount of money in an account. "Account balance" is the money available; "work-life balance" is the equilibrium sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Strategy: reach ADEQUATE, do not chase excellence.", từ "adequate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strategy: reach ADEQUATE, do not chase excellence.", what does "adequate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: adequate /ˈædɪkwət/ (tính từ): đủ đáp ứng. "Adequate" = vừa đủ, đạt yêu cầu, không cần hơn.
items.explanationEn: adequate /ˈædɪkwət/ (adjective): good enough for the need. "Adequate" means sufficient, meeting the need without going beyond.

items.question: Trong câu "Strategy: reach ADEQUATE, do not chase excellence.", từ "chase" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strategy: reach ADEQUATE, do not chase excellence.", what does "chase" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: chase /tʃeɪs/ (động từ): theo đuổi. "Chase perfection/excellence" = cố theo đuổi sự hoàn hảo; nghĩa gốc là rượt đuổi.
items.explanationEn: chase /tʃeɪs/ (verb): to try hard to achieve. "Chase excellence" means strive for it; the literal sense is to run after.

items.question: Trong câu "More is better — satisfaction rises proportionally.", từ "proportionally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More is better — satisfaction rises proportionally.", what does "proportionally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: proportionally /prəˈpɔːʃənəli/ (trạng từ): theo tỉ lệ tương ứng. "Rise proportionally" = tăng tương ứng theo mức đầu tư.
items.explanationEn: proportionally /prəˈpɔːʃənəli/ (adverb): in a matching ratio. "Rise proportionally" means increase in step with the input.

items.question: Trong câu "Examples: page load speed, storage capacity, battery life.", từ "capacity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Examples: page load speed, storage capacity, battery life.", what does "capacity" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the maximum amount something can hold
items.explanation: capacity /kəˈpæsəti/ (danh từ): dung lượng, sức chứa. "Storage capacity" = dung lượng lưu trữ; "team capacity" là nghĩa khác: lượng việc nhóm làm được.
items.explanationEn: capacity /kəˈpæsəti/ (noun): the maximum amount something can hold. "Storage capacity" is how much it holds; "team capacity" is how much work a team can do.

items.question: Trong câu "Strategy: invest deliberately, matched to the competitive position you want.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strategy: invest deliberately, matched to the competitive position you want.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪbərətli/ (trạng từ): một cách có chủ đích. "Invest deliberately" = đầu tư có tính toán, có chủ đích.
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪbərətli/ (adverb): on purpose, with careful thought. "Invest deliberately" means with a clear, thought-out intention.

items.question: Trong câu "Strategy: invest deliberately, matched to the competitive position you want.", từ "competitive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strategy: invest deliberately, matched to the competitive position you want.", what does "competitive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: competitive /kəmˈpetətɪv/ (tính từ): cạnh tranh. "Competitive position/advantage" = vị thế/lợi thế cạnh tranh.
items.explanationEn: competitive /kəmˈpetətɪv/ (adjective): relating to competition with rivals. "Competitive position" is where you stand against rivals.

items.question: Trong câu "Delighters (attractive attributes).", từ "attribute" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Delighters (attractive attributes).", what does "attribute" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: attribute /ˈætrɪbjuːt/ (danh từ): thuộc tính, đặc điểm. Ở đây là đặc điểm của sản phẩm; động từ "attribute to" /əˈtrɪbjuːt/ = quy cho.
items.explanationEn: attribute /ˈætrɪbjuːt/ (noun): a quality or feature. Here it is a product quality; the verb "attribute to" means to credit something to.

items.question: Trong câu "Lacking them, nobody complains; having them creates loyalty.", từ "loyalty" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Lacking them, nobody complains; having them creates loyalty.", what does "loyalty" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: loyalty /ˈlɔɪəlti/ (danh từ): lòng trung thành. "Customer/brand loyalty" = khách hàng trung thành với thương hiệu.
items.explanationEn: loyalty /ˈlɔɪəlti/ (noun): faithful support. "Customer loyalty" means customers keep choosing you.

items.question: Trong câu "Lacking them, nobody complains; having them creates loyalty.", từ "complain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Lacking them, nobody complains; having them creates loyalty.", what does "complain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: complain /kəmˈpleɪn/ (động từ): phàn nàn. "Complain about something" = phàn nàn về điều gì; danh từ "complaint".
items.explanationEn: complain /kəmˈpleɪn/ (verb): to express dissatisfaction. "Complain about something" shows unhappiness; the noun is "complaint".

items.question: Trong câu "Kano's most important insight: these categories MIGRATE over time.", từ "insight" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kano's most important insight: these categories MIGRATE over time.", what does "insight" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: insight /ˈɪnsaɪt/ (danh từ): nhận thức sâu sắc. "Gain insight into X" = hiểu sâu về X; "customer insights" = hiểu biết về khách hàng.
items.explanationEn: insight /ˈɪnsaɪt/ (noun): a deep understanding. "Gain insight into X" means understand X deeply.

items.question: Trong câu "Kano's most important insight: these categories MIGRATE over time.", từ "migrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kano's most important insight: these categories MIGRATE over time.", what does "migrate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to move gradually to another group
items.explanation: migrate /maɪˈɡreɪt/ (động từ): chuyển dịch dần. Ở đây là chuyển từ nhóm này sang nhóm khác; "migrate a database" là chuyển dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: migrate /maɪˈɡreɪt/ (verb): to move gradually to another group. Here it means shift between categories; you can also "migrate a database".

items.question: Trong câu "This is why products must innovate continuously just to stay in place.", từ "innovate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is why products must innovate continuously just to stay in place.", what does "innovate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: innovate /ˈɪnəveɪt/ (động từ): đổi mới, sáng tạo. "Innovate continuously" = liên tục đổi mới; danh từ "innovation".
items.explanationEn: innovate /ˈɪnəveɪt/ (verb): to introduce new ideas. "Innovate continuously" means keep bringing new ideas; the noun is "innovation".

items.question: Trong câu "Ensure every must-be is in the first release — they are preconditions, not options.", từ "precondition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ensure every must-be is in the first release — they are preconditions, not options.", what does "precondition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: precondition /ˌpriːkənˈdɪʃn/ (danh từ): điều kiện tiên quyết. "A precondition for X" = điều phải có trước để X xảy ra.
items.explanationEn: precondition /ˌpriːkənˈdɪʃn/ (noun): something required beforehand. "A precondition for X" must exist before X can happen.

items.question: Trong câu "Most remaining effort to performance on the dimensions your customers genuinely care about.", từ "genuinely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most remaining effort to performance on the dimensions your customers genuinely care about.", what does "genuinely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: genuinely /ˈdʒenjuɪnli/ (trạng từ): thật sự, chân thành. "Genuinely care" = thật lòng quan tâm; tính từ "genuine".
items.explanationEn: genuinely /ˈdʒenjuɪnli/ (adverb): truly, sincerely. "Genuinely care" means truly care; the adjective is "genuine".

items.question: Trong câu "A small slice for one or two delighters to differentiate.", từ "slice" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A small slice for one or two delighters to differentiate.", what does "slice" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: slice /slaɪs/ (danh từ): phần nhỏ, lát. "A slice of the budget/effort" = một phần ngân sách/công sức.
items.explanationEn: slice /slaɪs/ (noun): a portion or share. "A slice of the effort" is a share of it.

items.question: Trong câu "A small slice for one or two delighters to differentiate.", từ "differentiate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A small slice for one or two delighters to differentiate.", what does "differentiate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differentiate /ˌdɪfəˈrenʃieɪt/ (động từ): tạo sự khác biệt. "Differentiate from competitors" = tạo điểm khác biệt so với đối thủ; trong toán là lấy đạo hàm.
items.explanationEn: differentiate /ˌdɪfəˈrenʃieɪt/ (verb): to stand out from others. "Differentiate from competitors" means stand out; in maths it means take a derivative.

items.question: Trong câu "A product with charming features but missing the basics gets rejected.", từ "charming" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A product with charming features but missing the basics gets rejected.", what does "charming" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: charming /ˈtʃɑːmɪŋ/ (tính từ): hấp dẫn, dễ thương. "Charming features" = những tính năng làm người dùng thích thú.
items.explanationEn: charming /ˈtʃɑːmɪŋ/ (adjective): pleasant and attractive. "Charming features" are ones users find delightful.

items.question: Trong câu "A product with charming features but missing the basics gets rejected.", từ "reject" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A product with charming features but missing the basics gets rejected.", what does "reject" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ (động từ): từ chối, loại bỏ. "Get rejected" = bị từ chối; danh từ "rejection".
items.explanationEn: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ (verb): to refuse to accept. "Get rejected" means not be accepted; the noun is "rejection".

items.question: Trong câu "A user authentication mechanism may deliver no direct value, but everything else needs it.", từ "mechanism" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A user authentication mechanism may deliver no direct value, but everything else needs it.", what does "mechanism" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a system or process that does a job
items.explanation: mechanism /ˈmekənɪzəm/ (danh từ): cơ chế. "Authentication mechanism" = cơ chế xác thực người dùng.
items.explanationEn: mechanism /ˈmekənɪzəm/ (noun): a system or process that does a job. "Authentication mechanism" is the system that verifies users.

items.question: Trong câu "Four kinds of dependency to account for:", từ "account for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four kinds of dependency to account for:", what does "account for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: account for /əˈkaʊnt fɔː/ (cụm từ): tính đến, xem xét. Ở đây là "tính đến"; "X accounts for 60%" là nghĩa khác: chiếm 60%.
items.explanationEn: account for /əˈkaʊnt fɔː/ (phrase): to take into consideration. Here it means take into consideration; "X accounts for 60%" means makes up 60%.

items.question: Trong câu "Scalability requirements must be handled early; retrofitting is not cheap", từ "retrofit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scalability requirements must be handled early; retrofitting is not cheap", what does "retrofit" (verb) mean?
options: bổ sung vào cái đã có
optionsEn: to add to something already built
items.explanation: retrofit /ˈretrəʊfɪt/ (động từ): bổ sung vào cái đã có. "Retrofit security/scalability" = gắn thêm vào hệ thống có sẵn, thường tốn kém.
items.explanationEn: retrofit /ˈretrəʊfɪt/ (verb): to add to something already built. "Retrofit scalability" means add it to an existing system, usually at high cost.

items.question: Trong câu "Waiting for a partner to open an API; waiting for a regulator's licence", từ "regulator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Waiting for a partner to open an API; waiting for a regulator's licence", what does "regulator" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an official body that controls an industry
items.explanation: regulator /ˈreɡjuleɪtə/ (danh từ): cơ quan quản lý. Ví dụ ngân hàng nhà nước là regulator của ngành ngân hàng; động từ "regulate".
items.explanationEn: regulator /ˈreɡjuleɪtə/ (noun): an official body that controls an industry. A central bank is a regulator for banks; the verb is "regulate".

items.question: Trong câu "Waiting for a partner to open an API; waiting for a regulator's licence", từ "licence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Waiting for a partner to open an API; waiting for a regulator's licence", what does "licence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: licence /ˈlaɪsns/ (danh từ): giấy phép. Chính tả Anh "licence" (danh từ), Mỹ "license"; "software licence" = giấy phép phần mềm.
items.explanationEn: licence /ˈlaɪsns/ (noun): an official permission. British "licence" is the noun, American "license"; a "software licence" is a related use.

items.question: Trong câu "How to handle it: rank by value first, then adjust for mandatory technical sequence — and record the reason whenever you break value order.", từ "sequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to handle it: rank by value first, then adjust for mandatory technical sequence — and record the reason whenever you break value order.", what does "sequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sequence /ˈsiːkwəns/ (danh từ): trình tự, thứ tự. "Technical sequence" = thứ tự bắt buộc về kỹ thuật; "sequence diagram" = biểu đồ tuần tự.
items.explanationEn: sequence /ˈsiːkwəns/ (noun): a fixed order of steps. "Technical sequence" is the order work must follow; compare "sequence diagram".

items.question: Trong câu "The $100 technique forces real trade-offs, but needs a cap to resist manipulation.", từ "manipulation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The $100 technique forces real trade-offs, but needs a cap to resist manipulation.", what does "manipulation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: unfair control for one's own benefit
items.explanation: manipulation /məˌnɪpjuˈleɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự thao túng, gian lận. "Resist manipulation" = chống lại việc thao túng kết quả; "data manipulation" là xử lý dữ liệu (nghĩa trung tính).
items.explanationEn: manipulation /məˌnɪpjuˈleɪʃn/ (noun): unfair control for one's own benefit. "Resist manipulation" means prevent unfair gaming; "data manipulation" is a neutral technical sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Record the reason whenever technical sequence overrides value order.", từ "override" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Record the reason whenever technical sequence overrides value order.", what does "override" (verb) mean?
options: lấn át, được ưu tiên hơn
items.explanation: override /ˌəʊvəˈraɪd/ (động từ): lấn át, được ưu tiên hơn. "X overrides Y" = X quan trọng hơn nên thay thế Y; trong lập trình "override a method" là ghi đè.
items.explanationEn: override /ˌəʊvəˈraɪd/ (verb): to take precedence over. "X overrides Y" means X wins over Y; in code, "override a method" is a related sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Prioritization is the Product Owner's non-delegable responsibility, and it must be continuous rather than one-off.", từ "non-delegable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prioritization is the Product Owner's non-delegable responsibility, and it must be continuous rather than one-off.", what does "non-delegable" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: unable to be handed to others
items.explanation: non-delegable /ˌnɒn ˈdelɪɡəbl/ (tính từ): không thể uỷ quyền. Từ "delegate" = giao việc/uỷ quyền; "non-delegable" = phải tự làm.
items.explanationEn: non-delegable /ˌnɒn ˈdelɪɡəbl/ (adjective): unable to be handed to others. From "delegate", to hand work to others; "non-delegable" means you must do it yourself.

items.question: Trong câu "Prioritization is the Product Owner's non-delegable responsibility, and it must be continuous rather than one-off.", từ "one-off" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prioritization is the Product Owner's non-delegable responsibility, and it must be continuous rather than one-off.", what does "one-off" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: one-off /ˌwʌn ˈɒf/ (tính từ): chỉ một lần. "A one-off task/event" = việc/sự kiện chỉ xảy ra một lần.
items.explanationEn: one-off /ˌwʌn ˈɒf/ (adjective): happening only once. "A one-off event" happens only once, not regularly.

items.question: Trong câu "Kano adds the satisfaction dimension value-cost analysis misses, and reminds you that expectations shift over time.", từ "expectation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kano adds the satisfaction dimension value-cost analysis misses, and reminds you that expectations shift over time.", what does "expectation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a belief about what will happen
items.explanation: expectation /ˌekspekˈteɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự kỳ vọng. "Meet/manage expectations" = đáp ứng/quản lý kỳ vọng — cụm rất hay dùng trong công việc.
items.explanationEn: expectation /ˌekspekˈteɪʃn/ (noun): a belief about what will happen. "Meet or manage expectations" is a very common workplace phrase.
